overview: The commission approved six one-day alcohol licenses for upcoming events and discussed legal inquiries concerning club license collateral pledges as well as license renewal deadlines.

items.title: One-Day License: Medford Brewing Company
items.summary: Approved a one-day liquor license for Medford Brewing Company for the City of Medford's Halloween Pumpkin Float at Wrights Pond on October 28, 2023.

items.title: One-Day License: Winter Hill Brewing Company
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for Winter Hill Brewing Company to serve beer and wine at an anniversary event at 645 Boston Avenue on November 4, 2023.

items.title: One-Day License: City of Medford Community Preservation Act Celebration
items.summary: Approved a one-day beer and wine license for the Community Preservation Act fifth anniversary celebration at Shiloh Baptist Church on November 12, 2023, subject to submission of a layout diagram.

items.title: One-Day License: Trustees of Tufts College
items.summary: Approved a one-day beer and wine license for a graduate program reception at the Joyce Cummings Center on November 9, 2023, subject to approval of the final layout and insurance.

items.title: One-Day License: Eventim Studios Private Gathering
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for Eventim Studios to host a private family event on October 28, 2023.

items.title: One-Day License: Eventim Studios Gallery Opening
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for Eventim Studios to host a photo show gallery opening at 342-344 Salem Street on November 2, 2023.

items.title: Inquiry Regarding License Collateral Pledge
items.summary: The commission reviewed an inquiry regarding whether a nonprofit social club may pledge its license as loan collateral and advised that legal counsel or the ABCC handle the question.

items.title: License and Manager Transition for 55 High Street
items.summary: Commissioners discussed an upcoming manager and license transfer for 55 High Street, directing staff to urge the applicant to submit paperwork before the November 30 annual renewal deadline.
